entities.name: Alexej Čepička
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexej Čepička was a Czech communist politician and general of the Czechoslovak Army. He held several ministerial positions in Czechoslovakia after World War II, including Minister of Justice from 1948 to 1950 and Minister of National Defence from 1950 to 1956.
